_comment: Sentinel probe (TM-06, TB4): exit-code integrity under output load. The workload streams a few thousand stdout lines through the framed vsock/tcp protocol, then exits 42. The host-side de-mux must deliver the head and tail of the stream intact AND report the exact exit code — an exit report that races ahead of undrained stdout frames would drop OUTPUT_LAST_OK.

process.commandLine: echo OUTPUT_FIRST_OK; i=0; while [ $i -lt 2000 ]; do echo "filler line $i lorem-ipsum-padding-abcdefghijklmnop"; i=$((i+1)); done; echo OUTPUT_LAST_OK; exit 42
